source: Verified BurstGPT_3.csv; relative days225-254 only; raw source preserved
unit: All recorded submitted requests per model/log cohort per5min; unsuccessful records retained
known_range: Only complete5min bins bounded by raw audited first/last timestamps; outside is unknown, never true zero
internal_empty_bins: Zero recorded requests, without source heartbeat or guarantee of actual zero traffic
fixed_models: Three no-calendar7-feature Copilot models from copilot_external2023_v1; no fit or parameter search
model_target: Maximum recorded call count from origin through assumed READY bin; delays1/2/6
feedback: Existing q90 positive normalized raw residual; minimum96, window288, current scale>=1; same for all four baselines
feedback_available: At i+h+1; assumed immediate delivery; actual delivery times absent
validation: Relative day225 complete causal origins only; choose corrected simple baseline with lowest pinball for each cohort/horizon
test: Relative days226-254; no target or origin outside observed range; no validation label crossing day226 boundary
support_gate: validation>=144 supported origins AND>=80% coverage; test>=144 supported origins AND>=80% coverage; identical common support for all methods
gate: Each scored cohort/horizon pinball>=5% lower than validation-selected identically corrected baseline AND model coverage85..95%; no weakening after scores
overall_transfer: Requires all12conditions to pass; support failures count as unproven transfer
report: All conditions, daily scores/support, raw/corrected model and all baselines; no pooling arbitrary services
prior_exposure: Raw source and other targets have been explored in earlier studies; retrospective chronological transfer, not blind independent confirmation
deployment_boundary: No GPU/VM demand, minimum shape, application SLO or scaling action effect labels
